policy: Only fields supported by completed Awoken research are promoted. Conflicting or version-sensitive values remain qualified rather than guessed.

records.name: Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Capsule Corporation Time Rift; complete the Saiyan transformation quest chain.
records.mechanics_notes: Stage chain: Super Saiyan -> Super Saiyan 2 -> Super Saiyan 3. Current research supports the classic Saiyan transformation branch; exact intermediate quest checkpoint remains source-sensitive.

records.name: Super Saiyan God
records.unlock_method: Use Shenron's Super Saiyan God wish after maxing friendship with Goku, Gohan (Adult) & Videl, Gotenks, Vegeta and Pan.
records.mechanics_notes: +60% Basic Attack, approximately +50% Ki recovery and +12.5% movement speed in the maintained mechanics corpus; does not directly increase Strike/Ki Blast skill damage. Ki-recovery percentage is retained as source-sensitive because current sources disagree between 50% and 60%.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Reach level 90 or higher, max Whis friendship, and complete the Whis unlock interaction.
records.mechanics_notes: +25% all attack and +5% damage resistance; -10% Ki restoration/auto-recovery.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
records.unlock_method: Reach level 95 or higher, max Vegeta friendship after acquiring SSGSS, then complete the Whis unlock interaction.
records.mechanics_notes: +35% all attack and +10% damage resistance; -18% Ki restoration/auto-recovery.

records.name: Future Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Collect the five Distorted Time Eggs and complete the resulting Unknown History/Special Time Patrol story sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: +10% Strike and +5% Ki Blast; faster Stamina regeneration behavior is supported, while conflicting in-game wording remains noted in historical research.

records.name: Super Vegeta
records.unlock_method: Reach the required Saiyan level progression and complete the final Vegeta transformation challenge at Capsule Corporation.
records.mechanics_notes: +5% Strike, +10% Ki Blast and +5% Blast Defense. Stage 2 is Super Vegeta 2.

records.name: Purification
records.unlock_method: Reach level 35, create all required Majin Buu family members, then complete the associated Majin Buu House progression.
records.mechanics_notes: Replaces the normal moveset with a Kid Buu-style moveset; transformation-specific Stamina/resource behavior remains version-sensitive.

records.name: Become Giant
records.unlock_method: Reach level 35 and complete the Namekian Awakening/Guru's House progression.
records.mechanics_notes: Giant Namekian moveset with hyper armor; technical research records 20 Stamina/sec and restricted Ultimate/evasive use.

records.name: Turn Golden
records.unlock_method: Complete the Frieza Force quests at Frieza's Spaceship, including the final transformation progression.
records.mechanics_notes: +30% Ki Blast and +20% movement speed; resource behavior remains version-sensitive.

records.name: Power Pole Pro
records.unlock_method: Reach level 35 and complete the Great Saiyaman/Hercule's House questline.
records.mechanics_notes: Nimbus and Power Pole moveset; transformation ends on hitstun or grab.

records.name: Kaioken
records.unlock_method: Chance to obtain from Parallel Quest 8 Ultimate Finish.
records.mechanics_notes: Base stage of Kaioken; higher stages are represented through the parent record.

records.name: Potential Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Z-rank the five prerequisite Advancement Tests, then complete the final Super Class Advancement Test; the final test awards Potential Unleashed.
records.source_quest_or_shop: Conton City Patroller Academy / Advancement Tests
records.mechanics_notes: +15% all attack and +5% damage resistance; 500 Ki required. Historical sources differ on exact final-test rank wording. Claims of an actual Ki-recovery bonus are not promoted because the maintained research corpus flags the in-game recovery wording as misleading.

records.name: Beast
records.unlock_method: Max friendship with Gohan & Videl and Piccolo, then use Piccolo's additional training path and complete the Cell Max training mission.
records.mechanics_notes: Consumes 500 Ki on activation; +30% all attack and approximately -20% defense / +20% damage taken; +20% Ki recovery. Exact presentation differs between stat-table conventions.

records.name: Ultra Instinct
records.unlock_method: Defeat Jiren (Full Power) in the special training battle.
records.mechanics_notes: Requires 500 Ki but does not consume the five Ki bars on activation in the current version. No attack/defense modifier; auto-dodge costs 100 Stamina.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.unlock_method: Own/install Future Saga Chapter 4 and complete Quest No. 31, Ultimate All-Out Showdown, the final DLC story mission.
records.mechanics_notes: Two-stage transformation. Current 2026 research supports a roughly 12-second second stage with effectively unlimited/rapid Ki and health drain; exact cooldown and some stage-1 values remain unresolved.

excluded_note: These are staged forms represented through their parent Awoken records rather than separate canonical transformation records.
